note: The attacker-controlled PDB header selects the pixel packing mode and therefore how many bytes are expected per scanline.
The decoder computes the packed raster size from the chosen bits_per_pixel and image dimensions.
The packed pixel buffer is allocated larger than the exact raster size, but the extra bytes are not initialized.
For 1-bit images, the writer later reads every scanline byte from the decoded pixel buffer; any bytes left uninitialized can be propagated into output or analysis paths.
